fusions.name: Drover's Reach
fusions.desc: Casts a link at the first enemy it meets that deals 7 damage, rising 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Paddock Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 7-tile fence of links ahead of you for 8 seconds that blocks enemies. It deals 10 damage to each one it catches and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Pooled Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Huddled Close
fusions.desc: Each time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack, 25% in all at 5 stacks. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
